entities.name: Planeshift
entities.description: The second novel of the Invasion Cycle by J. Robert King, concluding the Weatherlight Saga.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who gathered nine planeswalkers, takes the Weatherlight to Urborg, is seduced by Phyrexia's beauty and joins Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian lord who plays on Urza's feelings and wins him over.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Leader of the invasion who cannibalizes Tsabo Tavoc and tempts Gerrard.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: Phyrexian cannibalized by Crovax for her failures.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Leader brought to Keld by Freyalise.

entities.name: Lin Sivvi
entities.description: Ally of Eladamri brought to Keld.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker who brings Eladamri and Lin Sivvi's forces to Keld.

entities.name: Astor
entities.description: Keldon warlord who joins forces with the Skyshroud elves.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: Dragon lord who learns he is the red Primeval, resurrects other dragons, and ends by plunging into a volcano.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Planeswalker who tells Darigaaz of the primevals, then betrays the planeswalkers.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Planeswalker killed by Tevesh Szat's betrayal.

entities.name: Daria
entities.description: Planeswalker killed by Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Planeswalker who confronts Urza.

entities.name: Agnate
entities.description: Metathran commander who allies with Dralnu and is poisoned by him; signs over his forces to Grizzlegom.

entities.name: Dralnu
entities.description: Lich lord of the underground city Vhelnish who allies with Agnate but plots to take his army; killed by Grizzlegom.

entities.name: Grizzlegom
entities.description: Minotaur commander who mercy kills Agnate and kills Dralnu.

entities.name: Tajamin
entities.description: Uses her holy cudgel to melt the glacier on which the battle is fought.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member who duels and kills Greven il-Vec.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: Phyrexian-aligned captain of the Predator, killed by Tahngarth.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Sends the disabled Predator crashing into the Stronghold.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Mage revealed as Phyrexian who teleports Gerrard and Squee into the Stronghold.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Weatherlight captain who pledges allegiance to Yawgmoth in the Stronghold.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Goblin killed by Crovax and granted the ability to return from the dead.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Dead companion Crovax claims Yawgmoth could bring back.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Talks sense into Darigaaz and emerges with the Thran Tome claiming to know how to save the world.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, shown tortured in Phyrexia since the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Rith
entities.description: Dragon resurrected by Darigaaz, later imprisoned inside Nemata.

entities.name: Dromar
entities.description: Dragon resurrected by Darigaaz.

entities.name: Treva
entities.description: Dragon resurrected by Darigaaz.

entities.name: Crosis
entities.description: The final Primeval, awakened in a tar-pit; driven back into it by the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Nemata
entities.description: Creature that imprisons Rith.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship that carries the metathran, reinforcements and crew; crashes after driving Crosis back.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: Phyrexian skyship that attacks the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Golden Argosy
entities.description: Ship of the first lord of Keld that saves Keldons and elves.

entities.name: Thran Tome
entities.description: Item Karn emerges with to save the world.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The artificial plane that overlays Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane overlaid by Rath.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane the nine planeswalkers travel to.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Region where the Stronghold lies and the battle occurs.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Phyrexian seat of power now in Urborg.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Place where Eladamri's forces fight on a glacier.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Remains to which the dragons are transported.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: Site of the earlier battle.

entities.name: Vhelnish
entities.description: Dralnu's underground city.

entities.name: Hurloon
entities.description: Where the Weatherlight picks up a Minotaur army.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The invasion at the center of the novel.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Overlay of Rath onto Dominaria that brings millions of invaders.

entities.name: Metathran
entities.description: Forces of Agnate carried to Urborg.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invading force.

entities.name: Primevals
entities.description: Ancient dragons who ruled Dominaria before humans stole their power.

events.summary: The Rathi Overlay begins while the coalition recovers from the battle at Koilos; Urza's nine planeswalkers transport troops to key locations.
events.quote: The Rathi Overlay begins while the coalition forces are still recovering from the battle at Koilos .

events.summary: Urza takes the Weatherlight and metathran to Urborg; Crovax cannibalizes Tsabo Tavoc.
events.quote: Crovax , the leader of the invasion, cannibalizes Tsabo Tavoc for her failures.

events.summary: Tevesh Szat tells Darigaaz about the primevals; Darigaaz sets out to save the others.
events.quote: but Darigaaz sets out to save the others nonetheless.

events.summary: The nine planeswalkers attack Phyrexia with soul bombs; Tevesh Szat betrays them, killing Kristina and Daria, and Urza activates his kill rubric.
events.quote: Tevesh Szat betrays them, killing Kristina of the Woods and Daria .

events.summary: Agnate's metathran, caught in quicksand, are saved by Dralnu's undead, and they ally against the Phyrexians.
events.quote: are caught in quicksand but are saved by the undead of lich lord Dralnu .

events.summary: In Keld fallen Keldon heroes return fighting for Phyrexia; Tajamin melts the glacier, drowning Phyrexians, and the Golden Argosy saves most Keldons and elves and carries them to Urborg.
events.quote: Doyenne Tajamin uses her holy cudgel to melt the entire glacier on which the battle is being fought.

events.summary: The Weatherlight brings a Minotaur army from Hurloon to Urborg and the battle for southern Urborg is quickly won.
events.quote: the battle for southern Urborg is quickly won

events.summary: Agnate learns his illness was caused by Dralnu, who wants his army; Agnate signs his forces to Grizzlegom, who mercy kills him and then kills Dralnu.
events.quote: who mercy kills the metathran commander and then kills Dralnu.

events.summary: The Predator attacks the Weatherlight; Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec and Sisay crashes the Predator into the Stronghold.
events.quote: Tahngarth duels with Greven il -Vec and kills him

events.summary: Ertai reveals himself and teleports Gerrard and Squee into the Stronghold, where Crovax kills Squee to prove Yawgmoth can bring back the dead.
events.quote: To prove it he kills Squee, who is then granted the ability to come back from the dead.

events.summary: Darigaaz resurrects Rith, Dromar and Treva and learns he is the red Primeval; the four sacrifice themselves in a tar-pit, awakening Crosis, who completes the chain of power.
events.quote: Darigaaz himself is the red Primeval.

events.summary: Karn talks sense into Darigaaz, who plunges into an active volcano to stop the Primevals' complete power.
events.quote: Darigaaz sees his mistakes and plunges himself into an active volcano

events.summary: In Phyrexia Urza is grasped by its beauty and Yawgmoth gets him to destroy the master soul bomb; Urza activates his kill rubric when Taysir confronts him.
events.quote: getting Urza to join his side and destroy the master soul bomb

events.summary: Yawgmoth shows Urza his tortured brother Mishra; Urza leaves him and prostrates himself before Yawgmoth, and Gerrard pledges allegiance as well.
events.quote: In the Stronghold , Gerrard pledges his allegiance to Yawgmoth as well.

events.summary: Rith is imprisoned in Nemata; the Weatherlight drives Crosis back into his tar pit and crashes; Karn emerges with the Thran Tome claiming to know how to save the world.
events.quote: then Karn emerges with the Thran Tome , saying he knows what to do to save the world.
